opportunity.title: Financial Management Software and Support Services (RFI)
opportunity.description: Request for Information only, for market research, issued by the First Responder Network Authority (FirstNet Authority). The government is seeking responses from entities able to provide financial management software and support services, and will use responses to decide the acquisition method, including whether a set-aside is possible. Amendment 002 extended the response date to October 26, 2026. Amendment 001 clarified the number of users for market research pricing. The contemplated NAICS code is 541519 Other Computer Related Services; Information Technology Value Added Resellers.

Its mandate is to ensure the building, deployment, and operation of a nationwide interoperable broadband network for public safety (the Nationwide Public Safety Broadband Network, or NPSBN). rationale.point: The RFI is full and open under NAICS 541519, which matches the company's registered NAICS code, confirming eligibility per the eligibility gate.
The company's places of performance include remote work, and the eligibility gate confirmed place_of_performance compatibility, supporting ability to perform.

The company has three relevant web and data platform projects for state/local agencies (under $500K each), but no prior federal prime contracts, which may limit competitiveness for a potential large contract given the award history median of $27M.
The listed point of contact Adam Powell at FirstNet provides a direct channel to engage and shape requirements, which is valuable for a small business seeking federal visibility.

risks: Potential eventual contract size (median top award $27M) far exceeds company's past project scale (<$500K).
No facility clearance or SOC 2 report may be required for a future financial management system contract.
Full and open competition with no small-business set-aside favors large, established contractors.
Lack of prior VA, DoD, or HHS prime contracts reduces credibility for federal financial systems work.
nextSteps: Submit a capability response to the RFI highlighting relevant web/data platform experience and remote performance capacity.
Contact Adam Powell (adam.powell@firstnet.gov) to express interest and request information on acquisition timeline and potential set-aside decisions.
Evaluate team capacity and consider teaming with a larger firm for a future proposal if a solicitation is issued.
Monitor SAM.gov for any follow-on solicitation (RFP/TO) and reassess bid decision at that time.
